affected_subject.reason: Identifies FastAccessVault.rebalanceFunds() as the affected function.

trigger_or_action.reason: Anyone can call rebalanceFunds() unlimited times, including immediately after processTransfer() redemption, triggering external custodian transfer.

direct_effect.reason: Vault becomes temporarily under-collateralized causing other redemptions to fail, and reentrancy can drain excess twice.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected access control and nonReentrant protection vs actual unrestricted call and external call without guard, plus collateralization state relation.

summary: Report identifies the function, unrestricted trigger, concrete under-collateralization/reentrancy effects, and the missing access-control/reentrancy safety relation.
